intent: Five separate transparent pixel-art perk icon generations

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent pixel-art perk icon for a top-down fantasy dungeon roguelike reward card. Subject: one glowing ember-red flame-shaped crystal gemstone, golden-orange core, red-orange flame silhouette, magical increased projectile damage. Composition: exactly ONE isolated centered sprite, fully visible, approximately 75% of the square canvas with generous transparent padding. Art style: faithful old-school native 16x16 logical pixel art enlarged using exact nearest-neighbor square blocks; large deliberate clusters, simple highly readable silhouette, no tiny detail. Match a cute but dark fantasy dungeon pack with dark plum outlines, saturated violet midtones, cream-gold highlights and bright accent colors. Each logical pixel is a crisp equal-sized square. Limited palette, about 8 to 12 opaque colors. No gradients, no blur, no antialiasing, no realistic lighting, no soft glow, no lettering, no UI panel, no frame, no card, no floor, no background. Genuine transparent alpha behind the object, not a painted checkerboard. This is a production game sprite intended to be reduced to a real 16x16 PNG and displayed at integer zoom.
